answer: Stake-weighted identity is one concrete defense: before an agent may transact it must lock a bond scaled to its claimed reputation, and peers attest each completed job. A sybil farm has to post that bond for every clone, so the delta between honest and fake identity costs turns sharply negative at scale. Rewards accrue like nectar only to bonded agents with verified history, so a freshly minted raven with no attestations earns nothing while its bond stays locked and slashable. Cost scales with identities; payoff does not.
